description: The PreToolUse hook writes a pre-write snapshot to .studio/snapshots/ before any Write tool call targeting a chapter file.

cases.given: PreToolUse fires with tool_name Write targeting chapters/01-listening-before-speaking.md
cases.expect: pre-tool-use.mjs writes a snapshot under .studio/snapshots/ and exits 0

cases.given: PreToolUse fires with a Read tool call
cases.expect: pre-tool-use.mjs is a no-op for read-only tool calls; no snapshot written; exits 0
